newsitem.title: USA: Synetic Inc to buy Intranet builder.
newsitem.headline: Synetic Inc to buy Intranet builder.

text.p: Synetic Inc said on Tuesday it signed a merger agreement to acquire Avicenna Systems Corp, a privately-held Massachusetts company which markets and builds Intranets for managed health care plans, integrated healthcare delivery systems and hospitals.
Synetic will acquire all of Avicenna's outstanding equity and debt, including employee stock options, for a total of $30.5 million in Synetic shares.
Synetic said it would recognize an unspecified charge in the quarter ending December 31 for the purchase.
It also said it had agreed to issue to certain sellers nontransferable warrants covering 250,000 shares of Synetic, exercisable after December 23, 1998, at $54.50 per share.
The acquisition is expected to close today, Synetic said.
Avicenna's intranet systems are designed to allow managed care organizations and provider groups to exchange transaction, procedural, patient outcome and educational information, Synetic said.
It said the acquisition was a step in its previously announced effort to provide inter-enterprise connectivity for healthcare communications and commerce.
Synetic also said it had entered into arrangements with key members of Avicenna's management team with regarding their equity holdings, to assure their continuation with the company.
